title: Delhi High Court flags trend of adding rape charges to matrimonial disputes to force settlements
description: The Delhi High Court on Friday flagged a growing trend of women leveling severe sexual misconduct charges in matrimonial disputes to force their in-laws into settling the cases with hefty amounts of money.Justice Girish Kathpalia made the observation while staying trial court proceedings against two brothers-in-law of a woman who had accused them of rape and cruelty.The Court found substance in the arguments that severe charges like rape (Section 376 IPC) and molestation (Section 354A IPC) are i
